purpose: Compare infrastructure startup strategies against a 500 ms target; no production rollout

environment.host: isolated disposable controller on actual VPS
environment.network: guest external access blocked; controller-initiated fixture HTTP only
environment.memoryInspection: SYS_PTRACE added only inside disposable controller to read its jailed child smaps_rollup

measuredBoundary: Host probe request through successful unauthenticated Codex thread/start; cold variants additionally include disk/network/jail/guest setup and fixture bootstrap
excluded: manager account selection and lease creation
caveats: Warm VM figures use guest page caches heated by a preliminary Codex initialization.
Snapshot warm/cold figures include explicit guest clock correction. Cold evicts only this benchmark snapshot memory and source data disk, never global host caches.
Statistics are exploratory small-sample medians and observed ranges, not tail latency guarantees.
Some JSONL batches deliberately capture failed probes; failures are retained as evidence and excluded from timing aggregates.
Cold first preparation of cached-env is omitted from its steady-state median; it is included in raw sample 0.
Memory is a minimal no-repository fixture, not a capacity allowance for build workloads. Base image page cache is additional/shared and not fully attributed by per-process RSS.
Repeated thread/start proves local Codex usability, not a real message delivered to a model.
batches: sequential baseline and warm strategies; original 10 s snapshot-create timeout
snapshot create with 120 s timeout and 8 restores without clock repair
snapshot restore with explicit clock repair and alternating per-file cache eviction
four prepared VMs, concurrent local threads, paused idle/wake
four prepared VMs, fresh process concurrency, paused fresh process wake
